court: In the High Court of Madras
respondents: Tmt. Supriya Sahu Secretary to the Government Government of Tamil Nadu Health and Family Welfare Department Fort St. George and Another
sections_referred: Section 11 of Contempt of Courts Act, 1971
advocates: For Petitioner : Ms. M. Vasanthakumar for Mr. B. Divakaran
For Respondents : Mr. E. Sundaram Government Advocate
judgment_text:
Contempt Petition has been filed under Section 11 of the Contempt of Courts Act, 1971, praying to punish the respondents herein for willful and deliberate disobedience of the orders of this Hon'ble Court dated 19.12.2022 made in W.P. No. 4996 of 2008.

The Order of the Court was delivered by

Hemant Chandangoudar, J.:— Today, when the matter was taken up for hearing, the learned State counsel submits that the order dated 19.12.2022 passed in W.P. No. 4996 of 2008 has been complied with. Pursuant to the said order, which is the subject matter of the contempt petition, the services of the petitioner have been regularised and a proposal dated 04.02.2026 has been forwarded to the Accounts Department for the disbursement of the amounts due to the petitioner.

2. In the light of the above, the Contempt Petition stands closed preserving liberty to the petitioner to revive the contempt petition in the event the amount due is not disbursed.
